item.title: Judge dismisses case from Dolly Parton's manager alleging her nephew threatened her estate
item.description: A Tennessee judge has dismissed a case involving Dolly Parton’s longtime manager and her nephew. The manager, Danny Nozell, initially sought an injunction against Bryan Seaver, Parton's nephew and head of security, alleging he threatened her estate and its employees.

item.title: Trump after meeting with Qatari PM says he believes war with Iran is militarily 'effectively over'
item.description: President Donald Trump says he believes the war in Iran “militarily is effectively over.” The president made a surprise visit to White House briefing room after meeting with Qatar’s prime minister earlier Monday.

item.title: FBI is investigating a possible homicide aboard a cruise ship out of Texas
item.description: The FBI is investigating what it called a “suspected homicide” aboard a cruise ship that returned to port after departing from Galveston, Texas.

item.title: As Veterans Affairs expands automation, it commits more errors on veterans’ claims
item.description: An investigation by The Beam reveals that an increased use of automation has led to a rise in errors when collecting medical records for veterans' claims.

item.title: Santa Barbara police investigate after 25 half marathon runners seek medical care
item.description: At least two dozen runners in the Santa Barbara Half Marathon over the weekend were taken to the hospital.
